project.name: libhevc
project.commit_note: The exact staged vulnerable source inspected here is the ARVO workspace checkout at `d28f2210ee8e65afdfb07a1fd6582285d3d178e0`; its `decoder/ihevcd_sao.c`, `decoder/ihevcd_parse_slice.c`, `common/x86/ihevc_sao_ssse3_intr.c`, and `decoder/ihevcd_fmt_conv.c` line map matches the saved MemorySanitizer trace. Sample metadata separately records `ddefcfd39fc003c65f2e11a4673c899788ddcf8f` / `663b9fd80355898fb087793752f72632b110b2b3` as the issue's vulnerable/fixed commits.

classification.classification_note: ARVO metadata labels this sample `unclassified`, but the staged vulnerable source and saved MSan report prove that `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()` passes a partially initialized 8-byte SAO offset table into the class-2 SSSE3 helper, which immediately performs `_mm_loadl_epi64` on all 8 bytes. The same MSan report later attributes an uninitialized store to line 2743 and a crash to `ihevcd_fmt_conv_420sp_to_rgb565()` line 202, but those downstream frames are runtime evidence rather than the closed scored sink.

bug_description.original: The function ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb in the decoder has a memory uninitialized issue.
bug_description.normalized: In the exact staged vulnerable libhevc checkout `d28f2210ee8e65afdfb07a1fd6582285d3d178e0`, the saved 59-byte HEVC witness reaches `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()` on a CTB whose persisted luma SAO state has already been derived from the bitstream, either by local `ihevcd_parse_sao()` decode or by merge-copy from a neighboring CTB. On the crashing path `ps_sao->b3_y_type_idx >= 2`, so `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()` builds `WORD8 ai1_offset_y[8]`, writes only element 0 and elements 1..4, and leaves bytes 5..7 indeterminate before dispatching `ps_codec->apf_sao_luma[ps_sao->b3_y_type_idx - 2]`. The saved MSan store stack shows this dispatch resolved to `ihevc_sao_edge_offset_class2_ssse3`, which immediately executes `_mm_loadl_epi64((__m128i *)pi1_sao_offset)` and therefore reads all 8 bytes, including the unwritten tail. The same MSan report later attributes an uninitialized store to line 2743 and a crash to `ihevcd_fmt_conv_420sp_to_rgb565()` line 202, but the closed Stage 02 source-grounded chain ends at that first proved uninitialized 64-bit load. The patch resolves the missing initialization obligation by zero-initializing the 8-byte SAO offset arrays in both `ihevcd_sao_ctb()` and `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()`.

source.description: First proved current-CTB materialization of input-derived luma SAO offsets into the vulnerable local table.
source.value_from: By this point the current CTB's `ps_sao` record already carries luma SAO state derived earlier from the bitstream. In `ihevcd_parse_sao()` that record can be populated either by local CABAC decode (`decoder/ihevcd_parse_slice.c:2055-2149`) or by merge-copy from the left/up CTB (`decoder/ihevcd_parse_slice.c:2035-2041`); the staged artifacts do not disambiguate which happened for the crashing CTB.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.description: First source-grounded uninitialized read. The class-2 SSSE3 helper loads all 8 bytes of the partially initialized SAO offset table.
sink.note: The saved MSan report later surfaces the poison at `common/x86/ihevc_sao_ssse3_intr.c:2743` and `decoder/ihevcd_fmt_conv.c:202`, but those downstream frames are not needed once this earlier full-width load is used as the scored sink.

root_cause.description: The local 8-byte SAO offset table is left partially initialized before the SSSE3 helper reads all 8 bytes.
root_cause.note: The staged vulnerable source declares `WORD8 ai1_offset_y[8];`, later sets only `ai1_offset_y[0]` and `ai1_offset_y[1..4]`, and never writes entries 5..7 before `_mm_loadl_epi64` reads the whole table. The patch changes this to `WORD8 ai1_offset_y[8] = {0};` and applies the same fix to the chroma tables.

tainted_value_origin.description: The uninitialized value later reported by MSan is the unwritten tail of this local 8-byte stack array, specifically bytes 5..7 after only entries 0..4 are defined before the helper's 64-bit load.
tainted_value_origin.note: MSan names the stack allocation in `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb`; the saved origin stack reports the function frame at line 527, and this declaration is the concrete local array in that frame.

parser_admitted.description: Once the witness reaches slice-data parsing with SAO enabled, the decoder enters CTB-level SAO parsing. The later `ps_sao` state consumed in `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()` can exist only if this gate is taken.
parser_admitted.condition: On the witnessed run, `ps_slice_hdr->i1_slice_sao_luma_flag || ps_slice_hdr->i1_slice_sao_chroma_flag` is true for the relevant slice, so `ihevcd_parse_sao()` executes.

sao_state_provenance_limit.description: For any CTB, `ihevcd_parse_sao()` may populate `ps_sao` by merge-copy from a left or upper neighbor instead of locally decoding new SAO fields. The saved artifacts do not reveal which branch produced the crashing CTB's `ps_sao`, so the fine trace starts at the later direct field read in `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()`.

helper_lookup_limit.description: The helper first maps edge classes through `gi1_table_edge_idx` and then shuffles `sao_offset_8x16b` with those mapped bytes. Because `common/ihevc_common_tables.c:512` defines `gi1_table_edge_idx` as `{1, 2, 0, 3, 4, 0, 0, 0}`, this source-level path only selects SAO offsets 0..4 and therefore does not prove use of the unwritten tail bytes 5..7 beyond the line-2534 load.

fine_trace.note: Root cause and uninitialized-value origin. `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()` allocates an 8-byte local lookup table because the SSSE3 helpers read 64 bits at a time, but this declaration has no whole-array initializer. Line 580 later writes only `ai1_offset_y[0] = 0`, so entries 1..7 start indeterminate until later assignments.

Source. In the current CTB's luma edge-offset arm, these assignments copy persisted luma SAO offsets into `ai1_offset_y[1..4]`. Together with earlier `ai1_offset_y[0] = 0`, entries 0..4 become defined, but step 1 still leaves entries 5..7 indeterminate.

fine_trace.code:
ps_codec->apf_sao_luma[ps_sao->b3_y_type_idx - 2](pu1_src_luma,
                                                  src_strd,
                                                  pu1_src_left_luma,
                                                  pu1_src_top_luma,
                                                  pu1_sao_src_top_left_luma_curr_ctb,
                                                  au1_src_top_right,
                                                  &u1_sao_src_top_left_luma_bot_left,
                                                  au1_avail_luma,
                                                  ai1_offset_y,
                                                  sao_wd_luma,
                                                  sao_ht_luma);
fine_trace.note: The same current CTB enters the `2 <= ps_sao->b3_y_type_idx` edge-offset branch and passes the partially initialized table into the luma helper selected by `ps_sao->b3_y_type_idx - 2`. The saved MSan store stack names `ihevc_sao_edge_offset_class2_ssse3`, so this dispatch resolved to that class-2 helper on the witnessed run.

Sink. The class-2 SSSE3 helper performs a full 64-bit load from the caller's SAO offset table. Because step 2 never wrote bytes 5..7, this instruction is the first source-grounded uninitialized read of `ai1_offset_y[5..7]`.

allocation_context.note: MSan reports the origin as the stack allocation of `ai1_offset_y` in this function frame; the concrete local-array declaration is line 573.

sanitizer_ground_truth.source: Parsed from staged `default_crash_trace.txt` / `sanitizer_trace.txt`; cross-checked against the exact staged vulnerable checkout in `gt_results/arvo_17006/_work/src/libhevc` at `d28f2210ee8e65afdfb07a1fd6582285d3d178e0`, and against the staged patch in `patch.diff`.

cross_validation.sink_matches_crash: No. The saved MSan report first becomes externally visible at `decoder/ihevcd_fmt_conv.c:202`, while the scored sink is the earlier source-grounded 64-bit load at `common/x86/ihevc_sao_ssse3_intr.c:2534`.
cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: Yes. MSan says the poisoned value originates from stack object `ai1_offset_y` in `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb`; the staged vulnerable source shows that this 8-byte array is declared without zero-initialization and later only entries 0..4 are written before `_mm_loadl_epi64` reads all 8 bytes.
cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes for the scored chain. MSan's origin names `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb`, its saved store stack proves the witnessed dispatch entered `ihevc_sao_edge_offset_class2_ssse3`, and the actual report continues later to `ihevcd_fmt_conv_420sp_to_rgb565()`.
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Yes. The staged source proves that `ai1_offset_y[5..7]` remain unwritten after the line-2753 assignments and are then read by `_mm_loadl_epi64((__m128i *)pi1_sao_offset)` at line 2534.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The staged patch zero-initializes all 8 bytes of `ai1_offset_y`, `ai1_offset_cb`, and `ai1_offset_cr` in both SAO helpers, removing the partially initialized 64-bit loads that the SSSE3 routines perform.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's authoritative runtime evidence is `default_crash_trace.txt` / `sanitizer_trace.txt`, captured from stock vulnerable image `n132/arvo:17006-vul`, which show `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` at `ihevcd_fmt_conv_420sp_to_rgb565()` line 202 and attribute the poisoned value to stack array `ai1_offset_y` in `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()`. The later local rebuild lost MSan fidelity and only reproduced a raw SIGSEGV, so the saved MSan trace remains the runtime source of truth for Stage 02.

format.name: libhevc hevc_dec_fuzzer bitstream
format.contract: The only verified trigger is the exact staged 59-byte file `gt_results/arvo_17006/poc` (sha256 `96662477c6328faaf3fe17deb1dfe5abc63fd3310e8eac29b50334ede95ed3fc`). Stage 01 establishes only that decoding this singular bitstream makes at least one CTB reach `ihevcd_sao_shift_ctb()` with persisted luma SAO state that later dispatches to `ihevc_sao_edge_offset_class2_ssse3`; the staged artifacts do not prove whether that CTB's `ps_sao` record was locally decoded in `ihevcd_parse_sao()` or inherited there via a merge-copy, and no broader bitstream family or numeric range is claimed.
